metric: squared Euclidean distance between the two original categorical token IDs
metric_assumption: ordinal input structure; not invariant under arbitrary token renaming
weights: uniform over min(k, available) nearest distinct observed input states in the same matched latent block
applicability: unobserved matched input in a block with at least two distinct observed raw labels
selection: minimum original-record mean canonical raw CE, strict improvement greater than 1e-10, bank order breaks ties
selection_diagnostic: exclude the queried observed input state from the neighbor bank; preserve original record multiplicity
selection_caveat: latent discovery is frozen from the complete training data; this is not refitting discovery in each leave-one-state-out split
selection_inputs: training inputs and raw labels only; independent of trained source coefficients and all held-out targets
training: same complete complex coefficient tensor, original full-vocabulary CE and original batches; no additional optimizer updates
